rows.title: Categories and cap from the offer book
rows.defect: the categories are cut to the first one
rows.test: the categories, cap and citation are the dated term's

rows.title: Activation date and days left
rows.defect: the days left are counted from the quarter start
rows.test: the days left are counted to the activation date

rows.title: Only this quarter counts
rows.test: a September charge is left out

rows.title: The cap stops the 5%
rows.test: spend over the cap earns nothing more

rows.title: A stale promo is said
rows.test: a 19-day-old promo says it may have changed

rows.title: Only this card's rows
rows.test: another card's grocery run is left out

rows.title: Pending and other currencies are left out
rows.defect: the posted check accepts pending rows in any currency
rows.test: a pending charge and a euro charge don't count

rows.title: Only category merchants count
rows.defect: every merchant counts as a category

rows.title: A target counts from the opening day
rows.test: a charge the day before opening is left out

rows.title: Payments and credits are neither spend nor returns
rows.defect: statement credits are counted as returns
rows.test: a card payment and a statement credit change nothing

rows.title: The window end date
rows.defect: the month-end clamp is gone, so Jan 31 rolls into March
rows.test: Jan 31 plus a month is Feb 28

rows.title: No push to spend, no promised watcher
rows.test: the short path says spend only what you would anyway

rows.title: Fee vs credits from the year before
rows.test: a credit from 14 months ago doesn't count

rows.title: Which card
rows.defect: the first of several matches is taken silently
rows.test: two matching cards ask which one
